_comment: §∅ PARITY FIXTURE. The span list both ports must produce from synthetic_ppgdex_o2ring_pinned.txt. A LIST, not a count: the JS and Python ports once agreed on total sample count to within ONE while their span counts differed by eight, so a count-based fixture reports success about boundaries it never examines.

cases.1501: a 20-sample floor pin in the measured worst-severity band (10-40 samples, peak 40.2x sd at ~20)
cases.2201: the same pin SPLIT by an isolated 156 — must remain ONE span, or a sidecar emits 22% too many
cases.2901: a 199 ceiling pin carrying a 200 overshoot — ONE span across both, the tolerance being at-or-beyond the pin only
cases.absent: a 4-sample floor pin at row 3601 is deliberately NOT here: min_run drops it, and the plant proves the rail qualified first so the omission is a min_run verdict rather than a vacuous pass
